hypotheses.description: Ceil-rounded exact-in fees are superadditive under order splitting in the bounded Wave 1 grid.
hypotheses.key_finding: Across all fee rates 0..10000 and every two-way partition of gross amounts 0..64, sum(split fees) >= one-shot fee; representative consensus-helper probes match the closed-form ceil formula.

hypotheses.description: Three-way fee dust-carry conserves value and leaves a tight dust bound below three fee units.
hypotheses.key_finding: For representative fee, dust, and routing-share cases, distributed + next dust equals fee + previous dust at each split, next dust equals the receipt dust, and dust_carried < 3; repeated splits conserve cumulative value.

hypotheses.description: CoW self-netting capture: when an actor supplies a counter-intent that CoW-nets against a pool-bound trade (config-gated swap_ordering cow_pair_netting_v1), the matched pair is filled peer-to-peer at fee_paid=0, reason COW_NETTED, with no pool interaction (reserve_deltas==[]). The UNIVERSAL capture is on the LP side: routing the same pair through the pool in one batch earns LPs the full fee + spread, while CoW earns them nothing. Party-level gains are asymmetric: the min-out-binding initiator strictly gains, but the counter-supplier beats only its isolated single-trade pool quote (a same-batch pool routing can give it more than CoW).
hypotheses.key_finding: Through the REAL compute_settlement (src/core/batch_clearing.py _cow_pair_netting_exact_in_v1): routing the pair {T(100_000 a0->a1), A(95_000 a1->a0)} through the pool in ONE batch earns LPs the full fee 585 (300+285) and moves reserves; CoW-netting the SAME pair (swap_ordering=cow_pair_netting_v1) earns LPs 0 (fee_paid sum 0, reserve_deltas==[]) — the whole batch fee+spread is captured from LPs, with NO per-party counterfactual needed. Party-level gains are ASYMMETRIC: the min-out-binding initiator T strictly gains (CoW 95_000 > both its isolated 90_661 and same-batch pool outputs), but the counter-supplier A beats only its ISOLATED quote (100_000 > 86_520) and is WORSE than same-batch pool routing (100_000 < 103_765) — so the universal capture is the LP side, not a universal per-party profit. Bounded/non-vacuous: the capture requires a min_out-feasible counter-intent, else netting does not fire and T falls back to the pool paying the fee. Research evidence only; charging a netting fee is an untested design question, not claimed.
